'''''Meteor Strike!!''''' was a roller coaster ride that was located in [[Greentree Pointe]], on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]].

==History==
The ride was constructed during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], to commemorate a meteor that struct Greentree Pointe. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[heroes of Cularin]] confronted a group of thugs led by [[Phis Benlip]], next to the ride. The thugs fled onto the roller coaster and the heroes pursued them, causing a firefight on the ride.
